mark.alt: AgentKoin mark: two heavy corner brackets, top-left and bottom-right, whose ends angle inward to grip a solid square at the center. The square is the payment; the brackets are the escrow holding it until a verdict.
mark.description: Geometry on a 256 grid: two L-brackets 32 units thick with 96-unit arms, outer corner radius 10, arm ends cut 18 units inward; centered 68-unit square, corner radius 3. Colors: brackets ink or paper, square accent.

held.meaning: Payment held in escrow, awaiting verdict.

released.meaning: Verdict Complete: payment released to the provider.

refunded.meaning: Verdict Reject or expiry: payment refunded to the buyer.

partial.meaning: Verdict Partial: payout split between provider and buyer.

usage: Accent is only ever the held square; brackets are ink or paper.
No gradients, gold, shadows or outlines on the mark.
Minimum size 16 px (use favicon-16 pixel redraw); clear space = one square width on all sides.
